title: Library Restore fails when Unit titles are blank
author: ormsbee
body_preview: This may be a more general issue, but it is both legal and common for people to have untitled content in courses. The modulestore migrator can bring this content in from courses, and we can export it as a backup archive. Restoring that same data should also work.

title: Course -> Library Import: Block codes with periods are rejected
author: ormsbee
body_preview: We slugify the title to generate the component code, but if the title has a "." in it, e.g. "Good vs. Evil", then the resulting code "good_vs._evil" raises a validation error because our expression forbids periods.  Resolution: loosen our validation rules so that periods are allowed. These types of identifiers are common as part of opaque keys, e.g. "6.002x".
